faq.title: Everything you want to know.
faq.subtitle: A question that's not here? Write to support@gestionpro.app, we reply within 24 hours.

items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The Starter plan is free forever for 1 shop. The Pro plan includes a free trial with no credit card — you only pay if you decide to continue.

items.q: Does GestionPro work with a slow connection?
items.a: Yes. The app is optimized for unstable 3G/4G networks with smooth data loading and compressed network exchanges. Your data stays secure and accessible.

items.q: Can I use it on my phone?
items.a: The dashboard and POS are fully mobile. Touch targets ≥ 44 px, side drawers, sticky actions — designed first for smartphone, then adapted to desktop.
CFA Franc (XOF) by default, Euro (EUR) and US Dollar (USD) as needed. You can set the currency per shop, and consolidated reports are available in the currency of your choice.
TLS encryption for all communications, automatic daily backups, strict isolation per shop and per account. No third-party access to your data. GDPR compliance for European users.
Yes, anytime, at no cost. Upgrades are immediate; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle. No data loss when switching.
